text: Because projects that list impact certificates can prove community driven impact over time, the community organized around a certificate should be able to apply for and receive government tax credits as a continuing revenue stream rather than a one off award.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Impact Investing Innovation - From Impact 1.0 to 3.0 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4685567
